name: Open machine-readable structured Atlas knowledge
statement: Users can accomplish open machine-readable structured atlas knowledge while preserving user-owned meaning, usability and consent.
requiredProperties: Documented versioned JSON Schema, examples and independent parser for future AKF
Stable IDs, object types, nested/dated annotations, tags, provenance and typed explanatory edges
Asset manifest with hashes where available, locator kinds and explicit included-bytes status
Owner backup distinct from redacted public export and scoped AI-access export
Independent export/import round-trip preserving user meaning and relationships
User consent for model training separate from programmatic access, AI retrieval and public publishing
